# Forage United Kingdom

> A free guide to wild food in the UK: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 44 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/)

## Dishes

- [Elderflower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flower heads steeped overnight with lemon and citric acid, strained into sugar syrup.
- [Sloe gin](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/sloe-gin/): Pricked sloes steeped in gin with sugar from October until Christmas.
- [Dandelion and burdock](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/dandelion-and-burdock/): Old northern English soft drink brewed from the roots, with ginger and sugar.
- [Rose hip syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/rose-hip-syrup/): Wartime vitamin C syrup of rose hips, strained twice to remove the hairs.
- [Meadowsweet cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/meadowsweet-cordial/): Almond-scented cordial from meadowsweet flowers.
- [Elderflower fritters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/elderflower-fritters/): Flower heads in light batter, fried and dusted with sugar.
- [Moules marinière](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/moules-marini-re/): Mussels steamed with wine, shallots and parsley.
- [Samphire with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/samphire-with-butter/): Steamed samphire tossed in butter, beside fish.
- [Wild garlic pesto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Ramsons blended with hard cheese, nuts, oil and lemon.
- [Bramble jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/bramble-jelly/): Blackberries with crab apples for set, strained into a clear jelly.
- [Hedgerow jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/hedgerow-jelly/): Autumn's hedgerow fruits cooked together and strained.
- [Hawthorn ketchup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/hawthorn-ketchup/): Haws simmered in vinegar, sieved and sweetened into a fruity ketchup.
- [Rowan jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Traditional Scottish jelly for venison.
- [Nettle soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/nettle-soup/): Nettle tops simmered with potato and onion, blended with cream.
- [Laverbread with cockles and bacon](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/laverbread-with-cockles-and-bacon/): The Welsh breakfast of laverbread, cockles and bacon.
- [Sea beet and potato soup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/sea-beet-and-potato-soup/): Sea beet simmered with potato and stock.
- [Chestnut and mushroom roast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/chestnut-and-mushroom-roast/): Roasted chestnuts in a nut roast with mushrooms.
- [Wild garlic soda bread](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/wild-garlic-soda-bread/): Irish-style soda bread with chopped ramsons and cheese.
- [Blackberry and apple crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/blackberry-and-apple-crumble/): Blackberries and apple under a buttery crumble, with custard.
- [Gooseberry fool](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/gooseberry-fool/): Stewed gooseberries with elderflower folded into cream.
- [Bilberry pie](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/bilberry-pie/): Yorkshire 'mucky mouth' pie of bilberries.
- [Cranachan with raspberries](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/cranachan-with-raspberries/): Toasted oats, whisky, honey, cream and wild raspberries.
- [Gorse flower cordial](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/gorse-flower-cordial/): Coconut-scented cordial from gorse blossom.
- [Heather and honey tea](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/heather-and-honey-tea/): Dried heather flowers steeped with honey.
- [Rock samphire pickle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/rock-samphire-pickle/): The Shakespearean pickle of rock samphire.
- [Chanterelles on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/chanterelles-on-toast/): Chanterelles in butter with thyme on sourdough.
- [Cherry plum jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/cherry-plum-jam/): Golden jam of wild cherry plums.
- [Wild mushroom risotto](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/wild-mushroom-risotto/): Risotto with porcini and hedgehog mushrooms.
- [Sea purslane with sea bass](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/sea-purslane-with-sea-bass/): Pan-fried bass with butter-fried sea purslane.
- [Nettle and cheese scones](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/nettle-and-cheese-scones/): Savoury scones with blanched nettles and cheddar.
- [Steamed alexanders with butter](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/steamed-alexanders-with-butter/): Peeled young stems steamed and buttered like asparagus.
- [Sea kale with hollandaise](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/sea-kale-with-hollandaise/): Steamed young shoots with hollandaise, a Victorian delicacy.
- [Crispy fried gutweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/crispy-fried-gutweed/): Dried gutweed flash-fried crisp and salted.
- [Pan-fried razor clams](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/pan-fried-razor-clams/): Razor clams seared with garlic, chilli and parsley.
- [Mushrooms on toast](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/mushrooms-on-toast/): Field mushrooms fried in butter on sourdough.
- [Horseradish sauce](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/horseradish-sauce/): Freshly grated horseradish with cream, mustard and vinegar.
- [Medlar jelly](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/medlar-jelly/): Bletted medlars simmered, strained and set into an amber jelly.
- [Damson cheese](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/damson-cheese/): Damson pulp boiled down into a firm fruit paste for cheese boards.
- [Damson gin](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/damson-gin/): Damsons steeped in gin with sugar until Christmas.
- [Easter-ledger pudding](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/easter-ledger-pudding/): Cumbrian pudding of bistort, nettles, oats and egg, served with bacon.
- [Laverbread, cockles and bacon](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/laverbread-cockles-and-bacon/): The Welsh breakfast of cockles, laverbread and bacon.
- [Wood blewits with garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/wood-blewits-with-garlic/): Blewits fried with garlic and parsley on toast.
- [Knotweed crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/knotweed-crumble/): Young knotweed stems under an oat crumble, like rhubarb.
- [Gooseberry and sweet cicely fool](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/uk/dishes/gooseberry-and-sweet-cicely-fool/): Gooseberries stewed with sweet cicely and folded into cream.
